prompt: Night, close and straight on: the solid red porcelain-enamel disc of the sign fills most of the frame, glossy as wet paint, washed by a gooseneck lamp from above, the only red in the picture. At its edges, parts of the neighbouring cream letter troughs follow the reference letters exactly, their amber bulbs still burning; nothing is written anywhere. The black board around it mirrors the bulbs as rows of warm points, with a hard line of argon-blue tube light along the bottom edge. Drifting haze and fine rain catch the glow. Shadows fall to true black. Full frame edge to edge. Thanks.
